unit: Marked evals only; mark-interval-confined non-overlapping windows; session-level selection/validation. Correlated frames/windows ≠ independent authentication attempts.

decision_semantics.single_frame_approach_a: Approach A: native argmax + winning-score gates; identity failure → INVALID; never REAL from insufficient/uncertain tracking.
decision_semantics.median_real: Median of fasnet_real_score_avg over valid FACE_OK frames in a non-overlapping window confined to one mark interval. REAL if median >= real_min; SPOOF if median spoof_combined >= 0.85; else UNCERTAIN. n_valid < ceil(window_s) → INVALID.
decision_semantics.majority_vote: Majority of per-frame Approach A states among valid frames. REAL-tie → UNCERTAIN. n_valid < ceil(window_s) → INVALID.
